name: Bite By Night [⏳]
desc:
🦇 Bite by Night – Horror / Thriller Style

👍LIKE THE GAME + JOIN THE GROUP FOR A FREE PERK!

When night falls, the hunt begins…
Bite by Night is a dark multiplayer horror experience where survival isn’t guaranteed. Hide, run, or fight back as deadly creatures stalk you through the shadows. One bite can change everything.

🌑 Survive the night
🩸 Escape the hunters
👁️ Trust no one

Will you make it until dawn?
